name: setting-row
description: A settings line. The whole row is the control: title, current value, chevron — or a toggle.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a primary action; use button. Do not put a naked Switch beside a Text.

ux.behaviour: Title on the start, current value on the end, chevron after; TalkBack reads one Button
ux.why: A setting is one line, not three nodes

ux.behaviour: The whole row is 48 dp, scales while pressed, and fires a click haptic
ux.why: You tap the words, not a chevron

ux.behaviour: AppSettingToggle is the on/off cousin; the words are still the control
ux.why: A tiny switch is a miss

aiHints: Use AppSettingRow to navigate and AppSettingToggle to flip
Put the current value in value, not in the title
